faithBody: We confess God's sovereignty and grace: Scripture alone, Christ alone, faith alone.
footNote: Daily grace that opens without a connection
registerIntro: Registration is not required to use the app. It is only for those who later wish to join courses, Bible study, care, or missions support.
privacyNote: What you enter is stored on this device only and is never transmitted.
peopleIntro: Scripture is not a book of heroes. These are people who needed grace exactly as we do.
studyIntro: One step at a time. Each lesson is a passage, a short reading, and two questions.
audioUnsupported: Playback is not available on this device.
journalPrompt: Write one line about today's grace.
videoChannelLabel: YouTube channel URL or search term
